verdict.rationale: Reclaim.ai is an AI-powered scheduling SaaS that processes users' calendar data, so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question for this kind of product. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a training opt-out, a no-training policy, or any data-use control for model training. The community privacy objections are general and do not speak to training-data controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
